newsitem.title: USA: Chelsea GCA Realty Inc names president.
newsitem.headline: Chelsea GCA Realty Inc names president.

text.p: Chelsea GCA Realty Inc on Monday said it named Leslie Chao as president and chief financial officer and Thomas Davis as chief operating officer, effective immediately.
Chao has served as executive vice president and chief financial officer of Chelsea GCA since its initial public offering in 1993, it said.
Chao's added responsibilities include real estate development and construction and legal departments, Chelsea said.
The company said Davis joined Chelsea GCA in January 1996 as executive vice president for asset management. From 1987 to 1995, Davis was with Phillips-Van Heusen Corp, Chelsea said.
Company officials were not immediately available to provide further details.
